entries.name: Exercise: Run on the Spot
entries.content:
Exercise: Run on the Spot
The woman stands upright, feet hip-width apart, arms bent at a 90-degree angle. As she begins to jog in place, her chest lightly bounces with each lift of her knees. Her shoulders remain relaxed, and her elbows swing back and forth in rhythm with her steps, creating a balanced counter-motion to the lower body’s repetitive lifts. Her waist gently twists with each stride, accentuating her hourglass figure as her hips maintain a smooth, controlled sway.

entries.name: Exercise: Push-Ups
entries.content:
Exercise: Push-Ups
She begins in a plank position, her hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width, fingers spread for stability. Her back is straight, and her core is braced to prevent sagging. As she lowers her body, her elbows bend outward, her chest descending toward the floor while her lower back maintains a natural curve. With a controlled push, she returns to the starting position.

entries.name: Exercise: Sit-Ups
entries.content:
Exercise: Sit-Ups
She lies on her back, knees bent, feet planted firmly on the ground. Her arms are crossed over her chest or lightly behind her head to avoid neck strain. As she lifts her upper body toward her knees, her abdominal muscles contract, her chest moving forward and upward. At the peak, her body forms a V-shape before she lowers herself back down.

entries.name: Exercise: Jumping Jacks
entries.content:
Exercise: Jumping Jacks
She stands tall, feet together, arms resting at her sides. As she jumps, her legs spread wide, and her arms arc upward until her hands clap lightly above her head. On landing, her feet return together, and her arms swing back down to her sides in one fluid motion. The continuous cycle creates a dynamic, full-body rhythm.

entries.name: Exercise: Plank Holds
entries.content:
Exercise: Plank Holds
She lowers herself into a forearm plank, elbows directly beneath her shoulders, forearms parallel, and toes supporting her lower body. Her back is straight, and her head aligns with her spine. Her glutes remain firm, and her core tightens to keep her body in a straight line, avoiding sagging or arching.

entries.name: Exercise: Mountain Climbers
entries.content:
Exercise: Mountain Climbers
Starting in a high plank position, her hands are firmly planted beneath her shoulders, arms straight, and back aligned with her hips and legs. One knee drives forward toward her chest while the opposite leg remains extended. She alternates quickly, creating a running motion as her hips subtly rise and fall in sync with her legs.

entries.name: Exercise: Burpees
entries.content:
Exercise: Burpees
Standing tall, she drops into a squat, placing her hands on the floor in front of her. She kicks her legs back into a plank position before immediately pulling them back in and jumping upward, arms reaching high. Each cycle flows seamlessly into the next, maintaining a brisk tempo.

entries.name: Exercise: Plank Shoulder Taps
entries.content:
Exercise: Plank Shoulder Taps
Assuming a high plank position, her feet are spread slightly for balance. One hand lifts to tap the opposite shoulder while her core stabilizes her frame. She alternates hands in a controlled rhythm, ensuring her hips remain steady throughout.

entries.name: Exercise: Side-Lying Leg Lifts
entries.content:
Exercise: Side-Lying Leg Lifts
Lying on one side, her bottom arm extends beneath her head for support, while her top hand rests on her hip or in front for stability. Her top leg lifts upward in a controlled arc, pausing briefly at the top before lowering back down. The motion is slow and precise to maximize muscle engagement.

entries.name: Exercise: Glute Bridges
entries.content:
Exercise: Glute Bridges
She lies on her back, knees bent and feet flat on the floor, positioned hip-width apart. Her arms rest at her sides. Pushing through her heels, she lifts her hips upward until her body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees. After a brief pause, she lowers her hips back down without letting them touch the floor.

entries.name: Exercise: Donkey Kicks
entries.content:
Exercise: Donkey Kicks
Starting on all fours, her hands are beneath her shoulders, and her knees are aligned under her hips. One leg extends back and upward in a kicking motion, keeping the knee bent at 90 degrees. She lowers the leg back down with control before switching sides.

entries.name: Exercise: Side Plank
entries.content:
Exercise: Side Plank
She supports her body on one forearm, with her feet stacked or staggered for stability. Her body forms a straight line, and her free arm can rest on her hip or extend upward. The pose is held for time, maintaining perfect alignment.

entries.name: Exercise: Crab Walks
entries.content:
Exercise: Crab Walks
Seated on the floor, her hands rest behind her, fingers pointing toward her feet, which are flat on the ground. Lifting her hips slightly, she begins to "walk" backward and forward using her hands and feet, alternating limbs in a coordinated motion.

entries.name: Exercise: Russian Twists
entries.content:
Exercise: Russian Twists
Sitting with knees bent and feet slightly off the ground, she leans back at a 45-degree angle, balancing on her glutes. Her hands clasp a weightless "object" (or remain together), and she twists her torso side-to-side, bringing her hands toward the ground on each side.

entries.name: Exercise: Frog Jumps
entries.content:
Exercise: Frog Jumps
Standing with feet wider than shoulder-width, she squats deeply, touching the floor with her fingertips. From this position, she explosively jumps forward, landing softly and immediately returning to the squat to repeat.

entries.name: Exercise: Basic Squat
entries.content:
Exercise: Basic Squat
Standing tall, feet shoulder-width apart, and toes pointing slightly outward, she lowers her body by bending at the knees and hips as if sitting into an invisible chair. Her chest stays lifted, and her knees track over her toes. She descends until her thighs are parallel to the ground, then pushes through her heels to return to a standing position.

entries.name: Exercise: Sumo Squat
entries.content:
Exercise: Sumo Squat
With a wider-than-shoulder-width stance and toes turned outward at a 45-degree angle, she lowers her body in a squat, keeping her back straight and knees aligned over her toes. The descent is deeper than a standard squat, emphasizing the inner thighs.

entries.name: Exercise: Jacko Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Jacko Pose
A pose in which a person points their ass up. Their legs stretch open wide going back. Their chest almost touches (or does touch) the floor. Their arms go forward, bent, on the floor. They look forward in the same direction as their arms.

entries.name: Exercise: Bulgarian Split Squat
entries.content:
Exercise: Bulgarian Split Squat
With one foot placed behind her on an elevated surface (e.g., a bench) and the other foot firmly planted forward, she lowers her body into a lunge position until her front thigh is parallel to the ground. She drives through her front heel to return to standing.

entries.name: Exercise: Downward-Facing Dog
entries.content:
Exercise: Downward-Facing Dog
From a plank position, she pushes her hips upward and back, forming an inverted V-shape. Her hands press firmly into the ground, arms extended, while her feet remain flat or slightly elevated at the heels if flexibility requires.

entries.name: Exercise: Warrior II
entries.content:
Exercise: Warrior II
Standing with feet wide apart, she turns one foot outward and bends that knee to form a deep lunge, while the other leg remains straight. Her arms extend parallel to the floor, one forward and one back, and her gaze follows her forward hand.

entries.name: Exercise: Triangle Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Triangle Pose
Standing with feet wide apart, she extends one arm upward while reaching the other toward her shin or ankle, creating a triangular shape. Her gaze follows her raised hand, and her torso rotates slightly to open her chest.

entries.name: Exercise: Child’s Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Child’s Pose
Kneeling on the floor, she sits back onto her heels and extends her arms forward along the ground. Her forehead rests gently on the mat, and her chest lowers toward her thighs.

entries.name: Exercise: Cobra Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Cobra Pose
Lying face down, her hands are placed beneath her shoulders. She presses into her palms to lift her chest, arching her back while keeping her pelvis grounded. Her elbows remain slightly bent for a graceful extension.

entries.name: Exercise: Tree Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Tree Pose
Standing tall, she shifts her weight onto one leg, placing the sole of the opposite foot against her inner thigh or calf. Her hands press together in front of her chest or extend upward.

entries.name: Exercise: Cat-Cow Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Cat-Cow Pose
On all fours, she alternates between arching her back downward (Cow) and rounding it upward (Cat). The movement flows smoothly, syncing with her breath.

entries.name: Exercise: Chair Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Chair Pose
Standing with feet hip-width apart, she bends her knees and lowers her hips as if sitting in an invisible chair. Her arms extend upward alongside her ears, and her chest remains lifted.

entries.name: Exercise: Extended Side Angle Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Extended Side Angle Pose
From Warrior II, she bends her forward elbow to rest lightly on her bent knee or places her hand on the floor beside her front foot. The opposite arm extends overhead in a straight line, forming a diagonal from fingers to the back heel.

entries.name: Exercise: Half Moon Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Half Moon Pose
Balancing on one leg, she leans forward and places her hand on the ground or a block. Her other leg lifts parallel to the floor, while the top arm extends upward. Her chest rotates slightly open to the side, creating a balanced and elegant shape.

entries.name: Exercise: Seated Forward Bend
entries.content:
Exercise: Seated Forward Bend
Sitting with legs extended straight forward, she leans forward from the hips, reaching her hands toward her feet or shins. Her back remains long and straight, avoiding a rounded posture.

entries.name: Exercise: Camel Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Camel Pose
Kneeling on the ground, she arches her back and reaches her hands toward her heels, lifting her chest toward the ceiling. Her hips remain forward over her knees for stability.

entries.name: Exercise: Eagle Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Eagle Pose
Standing on one leg, she wraps the opposite leg around the standing leg and crosses her arms at the elbows, bringing palms together. She bends her standing leg into a partial squat to deepen the pose.

entries.name: Exercise: Bridge Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Bridge Pose
Lying on her back, she bends her knees, placing her feet flat on the ground near her hips. Pressing into her feet and arms, she lifts her hips upward, creating a gentle arch in her back.

entries.name: Exercise: Pigeon Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Pigeon Pose
In a lunge-like position, she brings her front leg forward with the shin angled across the mat and extends her back leg straight behind her. Her chest may remain upright or lower toward the ground for a deeper stretch.

entries.name: Exercise: Crow Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Crow Pose
Squatting with hands on the ground shoulder-width apart, she leans forward to balance her knees on her upper arms. Gradually, she lifts her feet off the ground, balancing on her hands.

entries.name: Exercise: Boat Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Boat Pose
Sitting on the ground, she lifts her legs and torso to form a V-shape, balancing on her sit bones. Her arms extend forward, parallel to her legs, and her spine remains long.

entries.name: Exercise: Reclining Bound Angle Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Reclining Bound Angle Pose
Lying on her back, she bends her knees outward, bringing the soles of her feet together to form a diamond shape with her legs. Her arms rest comfortably at her sides or overhead.

entries.name: Exercise: Upward Plank Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Upward Plank Pose
Sitting with legs extended, she places her hands behind her hips, fingers pointing forward. Pressing into her hands and feet, she lifts her hips toward the ceiling, forming a straight line from shoulders to heels.

entries.name: Exercise: Plow Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Plow Pose
Lying on her back, she lifts her legs overhead and lowers her toes toward the ground behind her head. Her arms rest flat on the mat or clasp behind her back for support.

entries.name: Exercise: King Dancer Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: King Dancer Pose
Standing on one leg, she reaches back to grab her opposite foot or ankle, lifting it behind her. Her other arm extends forward, and her torso leans slightly forward to balance.

entries.name: Exercise: Supported Shoulder Stand
entries.content:
Exercise: Supported Shoulder Stand
Lying on her back, she lifts her legs and hips upward, supporting her lower back with her hands. Her legs extend straight upward, and her body forms a vertical line.

entries.name: Exercise: Treadmill
entries.content:
Exercise: Treadmill Walking
She stands tall on the treadmill, setting the speed for either walking or running. Her stride is steady, with arms swinging naturally at her sides, and her steps land lightly on the belt.

entries.name: Exercise: Elliptical Trainer
entries.content:
Exercise: Elliptical Trainer
Standing on the foot pedals, she grips the handles and moves in a smooth, gliding motion, mimicking running without impact. She can alternate between forward and reverse strides.

entries.name: Exercise: Stationary Bike
entries.content:
Exercise: Stationary Bike
Seated on the saddle, she grips the handlebars and begins pedaling. She can adjust resistance for a harder workout, maintaining a steady rhythm or incorporating intervals of speed.

entries.name: Exercise: Stair Climber
entries.content:
Exercise: Stair Climber
Standing upright on the pedals, she mimics climbing stairs, stepping upward with a consistent rhythm while lightly holding the handles for balance.

entries.name: Exercise: Forward Fold
entries.content:
Exercise: Forward Fold
Standing with feet hip-width apart, she slowly bends at the hips, reaching for her toes while keeping her legs straight or with a slight bend in the knees. Her head hangs toward the floor, and her arms dangle freely or grasp her elbows.

entries.name: Exercise: Butterfly Stretch
entries.content:
Exercise: Butterfly Stretch
Seated with her feet together and knees bent outward, she brings her heels toward her groin and gently presses her knees toward the floor. Her hands can rest on her feet or ankles as she lengthens her spine.

entries.name: Exercise: Lunge Stretch
entries.content:
Exercise: Lunge Stretch
Stepping one foot forward, she bends the front knee and lowers her back knee toward the floor, keeping her chest lifted. Her arms can reach overhead or rest on her knee.

entries.name: Exercise: Handstand
entries.content:
Exercise: Handstand
From a standing position, she kicks up into a handstand, balancing on her hands with her feet together and legs straight. Her body forms a vertical line from her wrists to her heels, with her core engaged to maintain balance.

entries.name: Exercise: King Pigeon Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: King Pigeon Pose
Starting in a kneeling position, she extends one leg forward and bends the opposite knee, bringing the foot behind her. She reaches back with both hands to grab the back foot, gently pulling it closer while arching her back to open her chest and extend through the spine.

entries.name: Exercise: Front Split
entries.content:
Exercise: Front Split
She slides her front leg forward and the back leg backward, lowering her hips to the floor. Her hands can rest on the floor or reach toward her front, depending on her flexibility.

entries.name: Exercise: Scorpion Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Scorpion Pose
From a forearm stand, she arches her back and bends her legs, bringing her feet toward her head while keeping her body balanced on her forearms. Her chest opens as her legs curve over her back.

entries.name: Exercise: Wheel Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Wheel Pose
Lying on her back with feet flat on the floor and knees bent, she presses her hands into the floor next to her head and lifts her hips toward the ceiling, arching her back. Her body forms a bridge-like shape with the arms and legs, and her chest opens toward the ceiling.

entries.name: Exercise: Bow Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Bow Pose
Lying on her stomach, she bends her knees and reaches back with both hands to grab her ankles. Lifting her chest off the floor, she pulls her legs upward, creating a bow-like shape with her body.

entries.name: Exercise: Reverse Plank Pose
entries.content:
Exercise: Reverse Plank Pose
Sitting with her legs extended in front, she places her hands behind her with fingers pointing toward her feet. Pressing into her hands and feet, she lifts her hips toward the ceiling, creating a straight line from her head to her heels.

entries.name: Exercise: Standing Side Split
entries.content:
Exercise: Standing Side Split
From a standing position, she bends forward at the hips and lifts one leg high behind her, keeping her hips square and arms reaching for the floor or toward her lifted foot.

entries.name: Exercise: Headstand
entries.content:
Exercise: Headstand
Balancing on her head and forearms, she lifts her legs toward the ceiling, stacking her hips over her shoulders and keeping her core engaged for balance.

entries.name: Exercise: Straddle Split
entries.content:
Exercise: Straddle Split
Sitting with legs spread wide apart, she leans forward, keeping her spine long and chest open, reaching her hands toward the floor or her feet. She may also rest her hands on the floor and deepen the stretch by walking her torso forward between her legs.

entries.name: Exercise: Oversplit
entries.content:
Exercise: Oversplit
In the oversplit, she goes beyond the traditional full split by extending her front leg forward or back farther than usual, using blocks or props under the feet to push the legs into a deeper stretch.

entries.name: Exercise: Split in a Backbend
entries.content:
Exercise: Split in a Backbend
From a standing or kneeling position, she performs a backbend while simultaneously extending into a full split. Her chest opens wide as her back arches, and she uses her legs to stretch deeper into the split, while the arch in her back showcases the flexibility of both her spine and hips.

entries.name: Exercise: Lying Front Split
entries.content:
Exercise: Lying Front Split
Lying on her back, she lifts one leg up toward the ceiling while keeping the other leg extended on the floor. Using her hands or a strap, she gently pulls the lifted leg towards her head, keeping the opposite leg straight on the ground.

entries.name: Exercise: Butterfly Split
entries.content:
Exercise: Butterfly Split
Sitting with legs bent and soles of the feet pressed together, she pushes her knees gently toward the floor, lengthening her spine and leaning forward for a deeper stretch. The focus is on opening the hips and stretching the inner thighs while keeping a long spine.

entries.name: Exercise: Scorpion Split
entries.content:
Exercise: Scorpion Split
From a forearm stand or inversion, she arches her back and bends one leg, bringing the foot toward her head while extending the other leg into a split position.

entries.name: Exercise: Lying Straddle Split
entries.content:
Exercise: Lying Straddle Split
Lying on her back, she lifts both legs up toward the ceiling. Using her hands or straps, she gently pulls the lifted leg towards her head, keeping the opposite leg straight on the ground.

entries.name: Exercise: Split with Chest Open
entries.content:
Exercise: Split with Chest Open
In a high lunge position, she drops the back knee to the floor, extending her front leg into a split, and opens her chest to the ceiling while keeping her arms extended for balance.

entries.name: Exercise: Split with Chest to Thigh
entries.content:
Exercise: Split with Chest to Thigh
In a full split, she deepens the stretch by bringing her chest toward her front leg, keeping the arms extended forward or resting on the floor to deepen the stretch.
entries.comment: Exercise: Split with Chest to Thigh

entries.name: Exercise: Straddle Split with Backbend
entries.content:
Exercise: Straddle Split with Backbend
From a wide-legged straddle, she arches her back, reaching her arms overhead or holding her ankles as she leans backward into a gentle backbend while keeping her legs spread wide in a deep split.

entries.name: Exercise: Standing Front Split
entries.content:
Exercise: Standing Side Split
From a standing position, she lifts one leg high up to her head, usually holding it with one or both hands, though no hands is also possible.

entries.name: Exercise: Jump Squat
entries.content:
Exercise: Jump Squat
Starting in a standard squat position, she powers through her heels and leaps explosively into the air, extending her legs and arms upward. She lands softly, immediately transitioning back into a squat for the next repetition.
